Root cause: `flag_value` was only inferred when `type` was omitted, leaving it as `None` for explicitly typed flags. The parser therefore supplied `None` when the flag was used.

Changed `Option` initialization to infer the flag value for all flags, while still only inferring the parameter type when no explicit type is provided. Explicitly typed flags now set the opposite of their default and then undergo normal type conversion.

+                # default.
+                self.type = types.convert_type(None, flag_value)
 
         self.is_flag: bool = is_flag
         self.is_bool_flag: bool = is_flag and isinstance(self.type, types.BoolParamType)

final_text:
Root cause: `flag_value` was only inferred when `type` was omitted, leaving it as `None` for explicitly typed flags. The parser therefore supplied `None` when the flag was used.

Changed `Option` initialization to infer the flag value for all flags, while still only inferring the parameter type when no explicit type is provided. Explicitly typed flags now set the opposite of their default and then undergo normal type conversion.
